  <strong>2026-11-17</strong> – <a href="https://github.com/insin/control-panel-for-twitter">control-panel-for-twitter</a> <a href="https://github.com/insin/control-panel-for-twitter/releases/tag/v4.99.2">v4.99.2</a>
  <div><em>Browser extension which gives you more control over your Twitter timeline and adds missing features and UI improvements - for desktop and mobile</em></div>
  <details><summary>v4.99.2 release notes</summary><p>Visit the <a href="https://soitis.dev/control-panel-for-twitter" rel="nofollow">Control Panel for Twitter website</a> for installation links, more information about the extension, and FAQs (mostly about why Safari is so weird about extensions).</p>
<p>Follow <a href="https://twitter.com/ControlPanelFT" rel="nofollow">@ControlPanelFT</a> on Twitter or <a href="https://bsky.app/profile/soitis.dev" rel="nofollow">@soitis.dev</a> on Bluesky for updates.</p>
<h2>Changes</h2>
<ul>
<li>Added an Uninvert follow button → Use theme colour sub-option which lets you use the theme colour when restoring Twitter branding</li>
</ul>
<p>New UI:</p>
<ul>
<li>Added support for the Uninvert Follow button option</li>
<li>Changed the Retweets tab to no longer change the page title</li>
<li>Fixed sorting Following by Popular if we're defaulting it to Recent</li>
<li>Fixed the Following "Sort by" menu taking up space when hidden</li>
<li>Fixed making the Retweets tab visually active after an X UI change</li>
<li>Fixed active tab underlines not being themed after an X UI change</li>
</ul>
